title: Armory Readiness Manual
summary: Build combat kits around route pressure, modules, stance, and survival margin.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: Armory is not just bigger numbers. It is a readiness system: gear tier, modules, energy state, stance, loadout, and instability all decide whether a fight is controlled or expensive.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Pick one weapon path and one armor role before spreading upgrades everywhere. Carry a kit that answers the current hazard instead of every imagined fight.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Salvage parts, craft gear, test stance behavior, install modules, then use feedback from failed routes to refine the loadout rather than blindly climbing tiers.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: Energy capacity, instability, installed modules, and cosmetic trim can all live on the item stack. Read the tooltip before assuming a tool is ready.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: Index can describe gear records, Logistics can stage loadouts, PowerGrid can support charging loops, and TutorialCore can point out readiness gaps.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If gear underperforms, check energy, stance, module side effects, and whether the enemy or hazard is asking for a different answer.
